target_customer: Consumers who want to improve social and conversation skills (dating, work, everyday situations)
problem: People lack a safe, repeatable way to practice hard conversations out loud and get specific feedback.

founders.name: Jonathan Li
education: University of Michigan, dual degree in Computer Science and Business
founders.background_notes: YC page: Head of Product at Luvu (a16z-backed) growing revenue from $0 to $1.5M ARR in four months; earlier APM at Duolingo. A Fondo podcast says he built the app solo.

competitors.name: Rapport
competitors.what: Conversation practice app for first dates and meeting people

competitors.name: Conversable
competitors.what: Speaking coach with voice and text practice partners

competitors.name: Kodi AI
competitors.what: Social skills coach with a bear companion, $6.99 per month

competitors.name: Scroops
competitors.what: AI voice rehearsal platform for dates and hard talks

technical_complexity.rationale: Voice conversation with LLM feedback and an adaptive curriculum is achievable by one person with current APIs; the product work is curriculum and retention.

defensibility.rationale: Many near identical apps launched in 2026 and the product relies on third party models; the penguin character and curriculum are copyable.

market_need_then: The number of 2026 social skills practice apps and Duolingo's Video Call with Lily show demand for spoken AI practice; no Quippy user data found. A podcast notes the open question of whether users return without external pressure.

identity.mascot_or_character: Penguin described on the site as cute outside with a highly trained social mind inside
identity.visual_style: Playful consumer style with lowercase vignettes
identity.voice_and_tone: Warm, encouraging, playful; tagline The gym, but for your social life; reassures users You're not behind.

branding.brand_signature: Penguin mascot and the gym for your social life line

brand_strength.rationale: Friendly quip-based name and a mascot suit a consumer practice app, but no independent coverage or community evidence was found and Quip and similar names crowd search.

outcome_analysis: Quippy is a solo-founder Fall 2026 YC consumer app for practicing conversations. The founder has Duolingo and Luvu product experience, which fits a habit-based app. It is too early for an outcome. The category filled with similar apps in 2026, so retention and brand will decide it.
notes: Dealroom lists a $500k seed with hidden investors; single aggregator and no press, so no round recorded. YC lists team size 1 while the data file lists 'Fall 2026'. Outcome search found no shutdown, acquisition or reviews. Funding completeness pass: 500K seed recorded from Dealroom; date and investors hidden, null. Single database; the figure may be the standard YC deal.
